purpose: Fill missing open music generation mode with one independently distilled 4B-class XL model; don't confuse ACE Music v1/Flash hosted/future with released ACE-Step 1.5

additions.group: 楽曲生成の欠落補完：ACE-Step 1.5 XL 8-step蒸留音声DiTと楽曲計画LMの再現可能性
additions.reason_selected: 現行178資産にMERT FullSong音楽特徴抽出はあるが楽曲生成checkpointが未登録。公式ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turboは約5BのF32 DiT、8-step蒸留で完全な曲/歌声のテキスト・歌詞生成/cover/repaintを可能にする別学習済み状態。ACE Music v1ホスト専用や将来公開予定のv1 Flashとは同一ではない。XL Base/SFT、通常量子化、2B Turboを自動多重採用しない。
additions.quality_positive: 2026-04公開の4B級XL Turbo、公式HFメタデータは約4,987.3M要素F32で公開snapshot約20GB、MITモデルタグ。ACE-Step v1.5一次arXiv:2602.00744は音楽プランナーLMと音声DiT分離設計を発表。公式GitHubコードMIT、固定モデルrevisionを参照可能。既存MERTは解析専用で非代替。
additions.quality_negative: 主F32約20GBと作者BF16公称約18.8GBを同一実体として扱えない。共有LM1.7B、Qwen embedding0.6B、VAE等の別学習済み依存が必要。HFモデル独自pickle silence_latent.ptとtrust_remote_code実装は安全監査が必要。完全file SHA/selected bytes、全テンソル正確総数、モデルrepo LICENSE全文、実機HW性能未確認。各原音源権利・学習データ許諾は出版社自己申告。ACE Music v1本体の公開約束とは別。
additions.evidence_scope: Official ACE-Step HF model and files pages, fixed HF 40-character revision for XL and shared base, official GitHub source+MIT LICENSE pinned; paper arxiv; no weights downloaded or model code run.
additions.observed_access: Public official HF listing, MIT license metadata, source GitHub public. Actual payload access, license dependency rights and user disk unknown.

parameter_gate.count_scope: Publisher one-decimal million approximation for separate XL DiT checkpoint, NOT full learnt pipeline count
parameter_gate.evidence_kind: Official HF safetensors F32 model ~5B plus LM 1.7B, text embedding 0.6B and VAE, bounded substantially below 150B by publisher figures; exact full tensor census still required before download

restriction_assessment.scenario: Copyright or provider distribution restrictions might change. The future ACE Music Flash announcement is not a weight release.
